triggers.description: A grounded task needs semantic derivation of behavior, representation, algorithms, composition, observations, effects, ownership, or proof; a boundary problem or typed hole need not already be named.
exclusions: mere boundary presence or crossing without an unresolved semantic question
purely mechanical realization of a settled construction, unchanged check execution, review bookkeeping, rebasing, Ship, or Land
unrelated theoretical browsing or an invented task
category theory exposition without a concrete task unless explicitly invoked

triggers.description: At least two plausible routes materially differ in behavior, ownership, representation, compatibility, migration, effects, resources, invalidation, or proof.
exclusions: categorical vocabulary without a material delta

triggers.description: A task-grounded question calls for discovering, deriving, or discriminating law-bearing structure. May coincide with UNI-BOUNDARY; a named boundary, existing encoding, duplicated implementation, or completed challenger is not required.
exclusions: unrelated theory without a task-grounded question
repeating a sufficient derivation without a new material question

triggers.description: New execution evidence fires an invalidator or may materially change a current boundary nomination before the next affected mutation.
exclusions: same owner, law, falsifier, route, obligations, and invalidators under routine refinement

triggers.description: A consequential standalone Universalist decision must remain independently addressable outside an active Actuating or Architectonic run.
exclusions: The receiving workflow can reconstruct and adjudicate the decision within its current run.
Actuating or Architectonic composition; neither adopts a standalone durable decision.
Decision materiality without an independent durability need.

routes.description: Preserve an adequate incumbent that resolves the live semantic question or survives change pressure; do not emit ambient preservation ceremony.
Nominate the smallest adequate native construction or transformation, including results derived with sophisticated mathematics.
Nominate a retained advanced construction with a material native dividend and claim-appropriate effective witness; registry membership is not required and the route does not assert universality.
Report a witnessed obstruction to the affected required claim after constructive alternatives close; missing evidence and incomparable adequate candidates remain unresolved, not this terminal route.

instrumentation.rationale: Only independently durable standalone decisions need a plan-bound receipt. Inquiry may begin before an owner, typed hole, candidate, or final route exists. Required artifacts name applicable conclusion evidence, not admission prerequisites, mandatory headings, or extra reports. Reuse adequate arguments silently; unresolved evidence and incomparable candidates do not force a final route or receipt. Existing trigger and route identifiers are retained; historical receipts keep their original fingerprints. Mechanic attribution is ordinary, card:<id>, or derived:<name>, without changing proof strength.
